git add -A && git -c user.name="interlocking" -c user.email="noreply@localhost" commit -q -m "spike: measure platform behavior on Claude Code 2.1.233

Six load-bearing assumptions measured against the real binary via probe hooks
driven by headless runs. Results in docs/design/platform-facts.md, raw payloads
in test/fixtures/events/.

Confirmed:
- UserPromptSubmit receives raw typed text, INCLUDING registered slash commands
- unregistered slash commands skip hooks entirely -> approve/override must be
  real commands, and the slash-free 'il approve G0' alias is required insurance
- systemMessage is invisible to the model; additionalContext is visible
- PreToolUse deny genuinely blocks Write and Bash, reason reaches the model
- SessionStart additionalContext reaches the model's context
- hooks fire inside subagents with agent_type/agent_id in the payload
- hooks run under Git Bash on Windows; POSIX syntax is portable
- file_path arrives with backslashes while CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR uses forward
  slashes -- classify() must normalize both sides
